data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: i was friends with someone in middle school and now we are in high school and she's not cool. how can i distance myself? ASSISTANT:

It can be difficult to distance yourself from a friend when you haven't seen them in a while. One way to start is to be friendly but not too friendly. Avoid doing things that are exclusive and that she might interpret as excluding her. Reach out in an occasional manner and don't be too involved in her activities. Eventually she may get the hint and stop trying to hang out.
